lessons.title: Elon Musk says Tesla-SpaceX merger being considered
lessons.title_zh: 伊隆‧馬斯克表示正在考慮特斯拉與 SpaceX 的合併案

paragraphs.en: Elon Musk has announced that a potential merger between two of his biggest companies, Tesla and SpaceX, is under active consideration. Speaking during a financial call on Tuesday regarding SpaceX's quarterly business results, Musk expressed his personal support for the idea. He revealed that special committees within both firms have been formed to evaluate the deal, although they have not yet reached any final agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 伊隆‧馬斯克（Elon Musk）宣布，他旗下兩家規模最大的公司——特斯拉（Tesla）與 SpaceX——之間潛在的合併案目前正在積極考慮中。在週二針對 SpaceX 季度業務表現的財務電話會議上，馬斯克表達了他個人對這個想法的支持。他透露兩家公司內部皆已成立特別委員會來評估這項交易，儘管他們尚未達成任何最終協議。

paragraphs.en: A combination of both giants would create one of the biggest corporate mergers in history. Currently, Tesla is valued at around $1.5 trillion, while SpaceX is worth roughly $2 trillion. Although SpaceX builds space rockets and Starlink satellites, its cloud computing services for tech firms such as Google and Anthropic have become its most profitable division. Even so, SpaceX as a whole has lost $1.1 billion so far this year.
paragraphs.zh: 這兩大巨頭的結合將創造歷史上規模最大的企業合併案之一。目前特斯拉的估值約為一兆五千億美元，而 SpaceX 的價值大約為兩兆美元。雖然 SpaceX 製造太空火箭和星鏈（Starlink）網路衛星，但其為 Google 與 Anthropic 等科技公司提供的雲端運算服務已成為該公司最獲利的部門。即便如此，SpaceX 整體而言今年到目前為止已經虧損十一億美元。

paragraphs.en: Musk has increasingly tried to unite his various businesses under fewer banners. Earlier this year, SpaceX acquired the artificial intelligence firm xAI and the social media platform X. Furthermore, Tesla and SpaceX recently collaborated on a computer chip project called Terafab. Musk explained that combining the two firms makes sense because they share common interests in artificial intelligence, software, and advanced computer chips.
paragraphs.zh: 馬斯克越來越傾向將他旗下的各個企業整合到更少數的品牌之下。今年稍早，SpaceX 收購了人工智慧公司 xAI 以及社群媒體平台 X。此外，特斯拉與 SpaceX 近期還合作推動了一項名為 Terafab 的電腦晶片計畫。馬斯克解釋，將這兩家公司合併是合理的，因為它們在人工智慧、軟體和先進電腦晶片方面擁有共同的利益。

paragraphs.en: However, completing the deal will not be easy. Because Musk serves as the chief executive of both corporations, he considers himself conflicted and is not sitting on either special committee. Musk also compared discussing the merger to "tap dancing through a minefield." In the end, the choice belongs to the investors, and at least half of Tesla's shareholders must vote in favor of the proposal for it to succeed.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，要完成這筆交易並不容易。由於馬斯克同時擔任這兩家企業的執行長，他認為自己存在利益衝突，因此並未加入任何一個特別委員會。馬斯克還將討論這項合併案比喻為「在雷區跳踢踏舞」。最終的決定權仍掌握在投資人手中，而且特斯拉必須有至少一半的股東投票贊成該提案，合併案才能成功。

grammar.point: 現在完成式被動語態 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.explain: 句中以「have been formed」表示特別委員會「已被成立」，由 have been 搭配過去分詞 formed 構成被動表達。
grammar.example: He revealed that special committees within both firms have been formed to evaluate the deal, although they have not yet reached any final agreement.
grammar.focus: have been formed

grammar.point: 表讓步的副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞「Although」引導表讓步的副詞子句，說明雖然 SpaceX 擁有本業，主要子句則提出雲端服務是最賺錢部門的事實。
grammar.example: Although SpaceX builds space rockets and Starlink satellites, its cloud computing services for tech firms such as Google and Anthropic have become its most profitable division.
grammar.focus: Although SpaceX builds space rockets and Starlink satellites

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句尾以介係詞片語帶出不定詞「for it to succeed」，用來表達股東投票贊成是「為了讓提案能順利成功」的目的。
grammar.example: In the end, the choice belongs to the investors, and at least half of Tesla's shareholders must vote in favor of the proposal for it to succeed.
grammar.focus: for it to succeed

lessons.title: Andy Burnham faces climate revolt after approval of North Sea gas drilling
lessons.title_zh: 北海天然氣鑽探獲准後 安迪．伯納姆面臨氣候抗議風暴

paragraphs.en: The UK government is set to approve drilling at the Jackdaw gasfield in the North Sea. Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh and Chancellor John Healey will announce the decision in Aberdeen. This approval provides major support for fossil fuel companies like Shell and Equinor. However, it also threatens to trigger a serious dispute with climate campaigners and politicians who worry about Britain's environmental promises.
paragraphs.zh: 英國政府即將批准北海穴烏（Jackdaw）天然氣田的鑽探作業。能源大臣米亞塔．範布勒（Miatta Fahnbulleh）與財政大臣約翰．希利（John Healey）將在亞伯丁宣布這項決定。這項核准為殼牌（Shell）和挪威國家石油公司（Equinor）等化石燃料公司提供了重大支持。然而，這也可能引發氣候倡議人士與擔憂英國環境承諾的政治人物之間的嚴重爭端。

paragraphs.en: Conservative ministers originally approved Jackdaw in 2022, but a court ruling later canceled that decision because regulators failed to consider the carbon emissions from burning the fuel. Although the Labour government promised in 2024 not to issue new licences, officials argue that Jackdaw does not break this pledge because it is not a new licence. Defending this pragmatic choice, Burnham noted, “When people are struggling – you can’t ignore that.”
paragraphs.zh: 保守黨部長們最初於2022年批准了穴烏氣田，但隨後一項法院裁決撤銷了該決定，因為監管機構未能將燃燒該燃料所產生的碳排放納入考量。儘管工黨政府在2024年承諾不核發新許可證，但官員辯稱穴烏氣田並未違反這項誓言，因為它並非新的許可證。為了為這個務實的選擇辯護，伯納姆指出：「當人們在苦苦掙扎時——你不能忽視這一點。」

paragraphs.en: Environmental groups have expressed strong anger over the announcement. Tessa Khan, the director of Uplift, pointed out that Jackdaw will only cover about two percent of national gas demand. Furthermore, because the project will run remotely with few workers, it will not prevent job losses in the declining basin. Campaigners also warn that the government faces an even bigger test with the larger Rosebank oilfield, which will create much more carbon pollution.
paragraphs.zh: 環保團體對此項宣布表達了強烈憤怒。組織「提升」（Uplift）的主管泰莎．汗（Tessa Khan）指出，穴烏氣田僅能滿足約百分之二的全國天然氣需求。此外，由於該計畫將以遠端遙控運作且僱用極少工人，它並無法阻止這個日漸沒落的盆地流失工作機會。倡議人士還警告，政府將面臨規模更大之羅斯班克（Rosebank）油田的更大考驗，該油田將製造多出許多的碳污染。

paragraphs.en: This controversial move may harm political support among younger and environmentally conscious citizens. According to a recent survey, nearly one-third of voters said they would be less likely to vote for the governing party due to new drilling. While ministers hope to please energy unions in Scotland, many lawmakers worry that breaking environmental expectations will alienate voters who demand cleaner green energy instead of fossil fuels.
paragraphs.zh: 這項具爭議的舉措可能會損害在年輕族群與具環保意識之公民間的政治支持度。根據最近的一項民意調查，將近三分之一的選民表示，由於新的鑽探作業，他們投給執政黨的可能性會降低。儘管部長們希望討好蘇格蘭的能源工會，許多國會議員仍擔心違背環境預期將會疏遠那些要求更乾淨的綠色能源而非化石燃料的選民。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative clause with relative pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 在子句中作主詞，指代前面的先行詞 climate campaigners and politicians，用來修飾其身分特徵。
grammar.example: However, it also threatens to trigger a serious dispute with climate campaigners and politicians who worry about Britain's environmental promises.
grammar.focus: who worry about Britain's environmental promises

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle construction)
grammar.explain: 句首使用現在分詞片語 Defending... 作為主動的分詞構句，修飾主要子句主詞 Burnham，表示主要動作發生時伴隨的狀態或目的。
grammar.example: Defending this pragmatic choice, Burnham noted, “When people are struggling – you can’t ignore that.”
grammar.focus: Defending this pragmatic choice

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun clause as object)
grammar.explain: 連接詞 that 引導名詞子句，在句中作及物動詞片語 pointed out 的受詞，補充說明指出的具體內容。
grammar.example: Tessa Khan, the director of Uplift, pointed out that Jackdaw will only cover about two percent of national gas demand.
grammar.focus: that Jackdaw will only cover about two percent of national gas demand

lessons.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
lessons.title_zh: Google 排除影響英國銀行與網站的雲端中斷事件

paragraphs.en: Google Cloud announced that it had fixed an outage at its London data centre complex, named "europe-west2." The technical problem began early on Tuesday due to a power issue at a third-party facility. This disruption affected a wide variety of services in the United Kingdom, including major banks, delivery firms, small businesses, and government courts.
paragraphs.zh: Google Cloud 表示，已修復其位於倫敦名為「europe-west2」的資料中心複合設施的中斷問題。這起技術問題始於週二早晨，起因是第三方設施發生的電力問題。這場中斷影響了英國境內的各種服務，包括大型銀行、物流公司、小型企業以及政府法院。

paragraphs.en: Many digital services experienced severe interruptions throughout Tuesday morning. Popular financial institutions such as Revolut, Lloyds Bank, and HSBC confirmed that their customers faced issues. Individual users reported being unable to access money abroad or complete payments. Even the official court service reported problems with its remote hearing video system, while courier companies like DPD and postal services faced operational delays.
paragraphs.zh: 許多數位服務在週二整個上午都經歷了嚴重的干擾。包括 Revolut、萊斯銀行（Lloyds Bank）與匯豐銀行（HSBC）在內的知名金融機構皆證實，其顧客遇到了問題。個別使用者回報無法在國外動用資金，或是難以完成付款。甚至官方的法院服務也回報其遠距審理視訊系統出現問題，而像 DPD 等快遞公司以及郵政服務也面臨作業延誤。

paragraphs.en: The system failure created significant trouble for everyday individuals and small enterprises. One customer, Rachael Ellen, found herself unable to pay for parking at a shopping centre when her digital banking app stopped working. Meanwhile, Guy Baybutt, an employee at a family-run business named The Veg Box Company, explained that his company could not process customer orders or arrange delivery collections. He emphasized that small businesses could suffer serious financial harm because perishable food must reach buyers quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 該系統故障給一般個人與小型企業帶來了重大麻煩。一位顧客瑞秋・艾倫（Rachael Ellen）在數位銀行應用程式停止運作時，發現自己無法在購物中心支付停車費。與此同時，在名為 The Veg Box Company 的家族企業工作的蓋伊・貝巴特（Guy Baybutt）解釋說，他的公司無法處理客戶訂單或安排快遞收件。他強調小型企業可能會遭受嚴重的財務損害，因為易腐壞的食品必須迅速送達買家手中。

paragraphs.en: By Tuesday evening, Google Cloud stated that the issues were resolved and apologized for the inconvenience, promising to release a detailed analysis soon. The incident occurred exactly one year after a similar major outage hit Amazon Web Services (AWS). Professor Feng Li from Bayes Business School noted that "failures will happen" because large cloud systems are complicated, emphasizing that the breakdown showed how heavily modern economies rely on a handful of tech giants.
paragraphs.zh: 截至週二晚間，Google Cloud 表示問題已經排除，並為造成的不便致歉，同時承諾不久後將發布詳細分析。這起事件剛好發生在亞馬遜網路服務（AWS）發生類似重大中斷的一年之後。貝氏商學院（Bayes Business School）的李教授（Prof Feng Li）指出「故障終將發生」，因為大型雲端系統十分複雜，他強調這起故障顯示了現代經濟有多麼高度依賴少數幾家科技巨頭。

grammar.point: 名詞子句當受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 that 引導的名詞子句，在此句中作為主要子句及物動詞 confirmed 的受詞。
grammar.example: Popular financial institutions such as Revolut, Lloyds Bank, and HSBC confirmed that their customers faced issues.
grammar.focus: that their customers faced issues

grammar.point: 原因副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Reason)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞 because 引導完整的子句，用以修飾主要子句並說明其發生原因。
grammar.example: He emphasized that small businesses could suffer serious financial harm because perishable food must reach buyers quickly.
grammar.focus: because perishable food must reach buyers quickly

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 由現在分詞 emphasizing 引導的分詞片語，省略了相同的主詞 Professor Feng Li，並接續說明該人物所強調的觀點。
grammar.example: Professor Feng Li from Bayes Business School noted that "failures will happen" because large cloud systems are complicated, emphasizing that the breakdown showed how heavily modern economies rely on a handful of tech giants.
grammar.focus: , emphasizing that the breakdown showed how heavily modern economies rely on a handful of tech giants

lessons.title: Great white shark leaps from water and photobombs California beachgoers
lessons.title_zh: 大白鯊躍出水面並搶了加州海灘遊客的鏡頭

paragraphs.en: Over the weekend, beachgoers at Marina State Beach in California witnessed an amazing sight. While a group of friends were posing for pictures along the shore, a huge great white shark suddenly leaped several feet out of the ocean behind them. Online videos captured this dramatic moment as the creature appeared in the background of their photos.
paragraphs.zh: 週末期間，加州瑪麗娜州立海灘（Marina State Beach）的遊客目睹了一幕令人驚嘆的景象。正當一群朋友沿著海岸擺姿勢拍照時，一隻巨大的大白鯊突然從他們身後躍出海面數英尺。網路影片捕捉到了這個戲劇性的時刻，這隻生物出現在他們的照片背景中。

paragraphs.en: Officials from California State Parks confirmed the incident, stating that a shark with the features of a great white had indeed jumped out of the water at that exact time. Warning notices were quickly posted in line with official rules. The agency emphasized that "interactions between people and sharks are rare" and reminded the public that these animals play a crucial role in coastal nature.
paragraphs.zh: 加州州立公園管理局（California State Parks）的官員證實了這起事件，表示一隻具備大白鯊特徵的鯊魚確實在那同一時間躍出了水面。警示公告已按照官方規定迅速張貼。該機構強調「人與鯊魚之間的互動很罕見」，並提醒大眾這些動物在海岸自然環境中扮演著至關重要的角色。

paragraphs.en: Great white sharks regularly visit Monterey Bay. They travel to waters near Hawaii and return to the California coast in late summer and early autumn to feed on fish and seals. Recently, sightings have risen because changing ocean conditions caused by the climate crisis affect their migration. For instance, El Niño events create warmer seas, forcing these cold-water hunters to move north or swim deeper to find cooler waters.
paragraphs.zh: 大白鯊會定期造訪蒙特雷灣（Monterey Bay）。牠們游往夏威夷附近的海域，並在夏末與初秋返回加州海岸以魚類和海豹為食。最近，由於氣候危機造成的海洋狀況改變影響了牠們的遷徙模式，目擊次數有所增加。例如，聖嬰現象（El Niño）引發了較溫暖的海水，迫使這些適應冷水的掠食者向北移動或游入更深的水域以尋找較涼爽的溫度。

paragraphs.en: The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) lists great whites as vulnerable. These top predators can grow to six meters in length and weigh up to 1,800 kilograms. By hunting sick animals, they control prey numbers and stop diseases from spreading. Although movies like Jaws portray them as dangerous monsters, their populations fell by over 90% in some areas during the twentieth century due to fishing, habitat loss, and illegal hunting.
paragraphs.zh: 國際自然保護聯盟（IUCN）將大白鯊列為易危物種。這些頂級掠食者體長可達六公尺，體重可達一千八百公斤。透過獵捕生病的動物，牠們能控制獵物數量並防止疾病蔓延。雖然像《大白鯊》（Jaws）這樣的電影將牠們描繪成危險的怪物，但在二十世紀期間，由於捕撈、棲息地流失和非法盜獵，牠們的數量在某些地區下降了超過百分之九十。

grammar.point: 時間副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Time)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞 while 引導時間副詞子句，用來表示主句動作發生時，背景動作正在持續進行。
grammar.example: While a group of friends were posing for pictures along the shore, a huge great white shark suddenly leaped several feet out of the ocean behind them.
grammar.focus: While a group of friends were posing for pictures along the shore

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 以逗號連接現在分詞片語 forcing...，表示主要子句所產生的必然結果或附帶狀況。
grammar.example: For instance, El Niño events create warmer seas, forcing these cold-water hunters to move north or swim deeper to find cooler waters.
grammar.focus: forcing these cold-water hunters to move north or swim deeper to find cooler waters

grammar.point: 介係詞片語表方式 (Prepositional Phrase of Means)
grammar.explain: 由介係詞 by 加上動名詞 hunting，用來說明大白鯊達成維持生態平衡的方式與手段。
grammar.example: By hunting sick animals, they control prey numbers and stop diseases from spreading.
grammar.focus: By hunting sick animals

lessons.title: Vanessa Kerry is the new WHO envoy for health resilience. What's on her to-do list?
lessons.title_zh: 凡妮莎·季里是世界衛生組織健康韌性新任特使。她的待辦事項有哪些？

paragraphs.en: Dr. Vanessa Kerry has recently taken on the role of special envoy for health resilience at the World Health Organization (WHO). In this position, she defines resilience simply as being well prepared. According to her, global health requires strong systems and the proper ability to respond to any crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 凡妮莎·季里（Vanessa Kerry）博士最近接任了世界衛生組織（WHO）健康韌性特別特使的職務。在這個職位上，她將韌性簡單地定義為做好充分準備。據她表示，全球健康需要強大的系統以及應對任何危機的適當能力。

paragraphs.en: Kerry brings a strong background to this job. She serves as the director of global and climate health policy at Harvard University and is the founder and CEO of Seed Global Health. This nonprofit group has spent over ten years building resilience in lower-resource countries by training local medical students and healthcare workers.
paragraphs.zh: 季里為這項工作帶來了強厚的背景。她擔任哈佛大學全球與氣候衛生政策主任，也是「全球健康種子」（Seed Global Health）的創辦人和執行長。這個非營利組織透過培訓當地醫學生和醫護人員，在資源較少的國家建立韌性已超過十年。

paragraphs.en: Her dedication to global health partly stems from experiences in her youth. When she was fourteen years old, she traveled to Vietnam and witnessed severe poverty. Later, as a medical student, she worked in a Rwandan hospital and faced a terrifying, complicated childbirth without proper equipment. They succeeded through luck and memory, but the harrowing event showed her that the healthcare system needed profound changes.
paragraphs.zh: 她對全球健康的奉獻部分源自於年少時的經歷。當她十四歲時，她前往越南旅行並目睹了嚴重的貧困。後來，作為一名醫學生，她在盧安達的一家醫院工作，並在沒有適當設備的情況下面臨了一次可怕且複雜的分娩。他們靠著運氣和記憶成功了，但這場令人心碎的事件向她表明，醫療系統需要深遠的變革。

paragraphs.en: These lessons inspired her to launch her organization to train medical educators in sub-Saharan Africa. Recently, in Uganda, her group helped train thousands of local workers to handle an Ebola outbreak. She believes that teaching local staff is a powerful way to create lasting surveillance and prevention systems.
paragraphs.zh: 這些經驗啟發她創辦了她的組織，在撒哈拉以南非洲培訓醫療教育人員。最近在烏干達，她的團隊協助培訓了數千名當地工作人員來處理伊波拉疫情。她相信培訓當地員工是建立持久監控與預防系統的強大方法。

paragraphs.en: As the new resilience envoy, Kerry wants to change how international funding works. Instead of reacting crisis by crisis, she aims to help nations build proper health infrastructures in advance. By listening to local voices, she hopes to ensure that countries receive adequate support to address their greatest disease burdens.
paragraphs.zh: 作為新的韌性特使，季里希望改變國際資金運作的方式。她旨在協助各國提前建立適當的衛生基礎設施，而不是逐一應對危機。透過傾聽當地的聲音，她希望確保各國獲得充足的支持，以應對最大的疾病負擔。

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 使用 V-ing 形容詞來修飾名詞，表達主動或令人感受到的性質。
grammar.example: Later, as a medical student, she worked in a Rwandan hospital and faced a terrifying, complicated childbirth without proper equipment.
grammar.focus: terrifying

lessons.title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech
lessons.title_zh: 英國要求蘋果公司放寬其支付技術的使用權限

paragraphs.en: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) in the UK stated that smartphone users could enjoy better services if Apple widens access to its contactless payment technology. The watchdog believes that current fees and rules set by the iPhone manufacturer are blocking financial technology firms from growing and innovating.
paragraphs.zh: 英國的競爭暨市場管理局（Competition and Markets Authority，簡稱 CMA）表示，如果蘋果公司擴大其非接觸式支付技術的使用權限，智慧型手機使用者將能享受到更好的服務。該監管機構認為，這家 iPhone 製造商目前設定的費用與規則，正在阻礙金融科技公司成長與創新。

paragraphs.en: Nearly two in five payments in the region are now contactless, and almost sixty percent of people use digital wallets, with Apple's service being the most popular choice. The CMA wants the fees charged to companies to be substantially lower, and it is currently consulting on proposals to help achieve this goal.
paragraphs.zh: 該地區目前將近有五分之二的付款是採用非接觸式，且近百分之六十的人使用數位錢包，其中蘋果的服務是最熱門的選擇。CMA 希望大幅降低向企業收取的費用，目前正就各項提案進行諮詢以助達成此目標。

paragraphs.en: Apple maintains that its current arrangements protect security and privacy while allowing developers to create innovative products. The firm stated that it does not believe regulators should require lower privacy and security protections. Last year, Apple also warned against following the same path as the European Union (EU), which forced the company to open up its technologies.
paragraphs.zh: 蘋果堅稱其目前的安排在保護安全與隱私的同時，也允許開發人員創造創新產品。該公司表示，它認為監管機構不應該要求降低隱私與安全保護。去年，蘋果也曾警告不要走上與歐洲聯合（European Union，簡稱 EU）相同的道路，該道路曾迫使該公司開放其技術。

paragraphs.en: However, the regulator argues that its focus is on ensuring the interoperability of specific features, such as digital wallets and watches. The proposed measures could force Apple to grant access to an alternative contactless technology standard called Host Card Emulation (HCE), which is not currently permitted in the UK.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，監管機構主張其重點在於確保特定功能的互通性，例如數位錢包和手錶。這些擬議的措施可能會強迫蘋果開放使用一種名為「主機卡模擬」（Host Card Emulation，簡稱 HCE）的替代非接觸式技術標準，該標準目前在英國尚未被允許。

paragraphs.en: Sarah Cardell, Chief Executive of the CMA, said that high fees and strict restrictions make it too difficult for challengers to compete. She stated that removing barriers to entry can help create conditions for great businesses to develop new products and services.
paragraphs.zh: CMA 執行長莎拉・卡德爾（Sarah Cardell）表示，高額費用與嚴格限制使得挑戰者難以競爭。她指出，消除進入障礙有助於創造條件，讓優秀的企業能夠發展新產品與服務。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 用所引導的形容詞子句來補充說明前面的技術標準名稱。
grammar.example: The proposed measures could force Apple to grant access to an alternative contactless technology standard called Host Card Emulation (HCE), which is not currently permitted in the UK.
grammar.focus: which is not currently permitted in the UK

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 表示主詞受到動作的影響，使用「be 動詞 + 過去分詞」的結構。
grammar.example: Nearly two in five payments in the region are now contactless, and almost sixty percent of people use digital wallets, with Apple's service being the most popular choice.
grammar.focus: are now contactless

grammar.point: 表目的之不定詞片語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」來表達做某事的目的，在此指為了助於達成此目標。
grammar.example: The CMA wants the fees charged to companies to be substantially lower, and it is currently consulting on proposals to help achieve this goal.
grammar.focus: to help achieve this goal

lessons.title: Moment giant fin whale's huge mouth engulfs thousands of gallons of water
lessons.title_zh: 巨型長鬚鯨張開大口吞下數千加侖水的瞬間

paragraphs.en: A rare video captured by a videographer off the coast of Wales shows the second largest living creature on the planet opening its giant jaws. The fin whale took in thousands of gallons of water and krill during feeding time.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯海岸外的一名攝影師捕捉到了一段罕見的影片，顯示地球上第二大生物張開了巨大的嘴巴。這頭長鬚鯨在進食期間吞下了數千加侖的水和磷蝦。

paragraphs.en: Rhys Morgan filmed the mammal while fishing with a friend and using a drone. Morgan stated that it was complete luck to record the whale feeding while swimming with dolphins. He works at an oil refinery by day and became interested in marine videography after using his friend's drone.
paragraphs.zh: 瑞斯·摩根（Rhys Morgan）在與朋友釣魚並使用無人機時拍攝了這頭哺乳動物。摩根表示，能記錄下這頭鯨魚在與海豚一起游泳時進食的畫面完全是運氣。他白天在煉油廠工作，在使用了朋友的無人機後開始對海洋錄影產生興趣。

paragraphs.en: As the second largest animal ever to exist, the fin whale can reach twenty-four meters in length and weigh seventy tonnes. Despite this massive size, the fast-swimming animal is very elusive and spends most of its life in the open ocean.
paragraphs.zh: 作為曾經存在過第二大的動物，長鬚鯨的長度可達二十四公分，體重可達七十公噸。儘管體型龐大，這種游泳速度極快的動物卻非常難以捉摸，且一生大部分時間都在開闊的海洋中度過。

paragraphs.en: Dr Marianna Chimienti, a lecturer in marine top predator ecology at Bangor University, explained that it is normal for the species to feed at the surface. However, she noted that encountering one in coastal water is quite spectacular.
paragraphs.zh: 班戈大學（Bangor University）海洋頂級掠食者生態學講師瑪麗安娜·奇米恩蒂（Marianna Chimienti）博士解釋說，該物種在海面進食是正常的。然而，她指出在沿海水域遇到一隻是非常壯觀的。

paragraphs.en: Scientists discovered that these whales eat a simple diet consisting mainly of krill, small schooling fish, and squid. Because their prey is small, they must spend several hours each day eating up to two thousand kilograms of food to survive.
paragraphs.zh: 科學家發現，這些鯨魚的飲食相當簡單，主要由磷蝦、小型群居魚類和烏賊組成。由於它們的獵物體型很小，它們必須每天花費幾個小時吃掉高達兩公斤的食物才能生存。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participial Construction)
grammar.explain: 本句使用現在分詞片語作為附加的動作說明，與主句的主詞保持一致。
grammar.example: Rhys Morgan filmed the mammal while fishing with a friend and using a drone.
grammar.focus: while fishing with a friend and using a drone

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 本句使用關係代名詞子句來補充說明先前存在過的最大動物。
grammar.example: As the second largest animal ever to exist, the fin whale can reach twenty-four meters in length and weigh seventy tonnes.
grammar.focus: ever to exist

grammar.point: 副詞子句表原因 (Adverbial Clause of Cause)
grammar.explain: 本句使用連接詞 because 引導原因副詞子句，說明鯨魚必須花費數小時進食的原因。
grammar.example: Because their prey is small, they must spend several hours each day eating up to two thousand kilograms of food to survive.
grammar.focus: Because their prey is small

lessons.title: Giving £2 a day to people in the Amazon helps protect rainforest, pilot project finds
lessons.title_zh: 先導計畫發現：每天向亞馬遜居民提供兩英鎊有助於保護雨林

paragraphs.en: A groundbreaking project in Peru has shown that giving basic cash payments to Indigenous communities can help protect the Amazon rainforest. In a two-year trial organized by the British charity Cool Earth, 211 residents in the Asháninka region received six cash payments of 1,032 Peruvian soles each. This amount was worth about two pounds per day, and villagers were free to spend the money however they wished without any conditions attached.
paragraphs.zh: 秘魯一項開創性的計畫顯示，向原住民社群發放基本現金給付，有助於保護亞馬遜雨林。在一項由英國慈善機構「拯救酷地球」（Cool Earth）籌辦的兩年試驗中，阿沙寧卡（Asháninka）地區的兩百一十一名居民各獲得了六筆各為一千零三十二秘魯索爾的現金給付。這筆金額大約相當於每天兩英鎊，村民可以隨心所欲自由花費這筆錢，沒有附帶任何條件。

paragraphs.en: According to researchers from the University of Bath, the results were very encouraging. Almost ninety percent of the participants chose to adopt environmentally friendly habits, including planting trees together and restoring vital water sources. In addition, the percentage of families unable to buy healthy food dropped sharply from 73 percent to 26 percent. Fewer people had to leave their villages to search for jobs, which meant more residents stayed behind to look after the land.
paragraphs.zh: 根據巴斯大學（University of Bath）研究人員的說法，其結果非常令人振奮。將近百分之九十的參與者選擇採取對環境友善的習慣，包括共同植樹以及修復至關重要的水源。此外，無法負擔健康食物的家庭比例從百分之七十三大幅下降至百分之二十六。必須離開村莊尋找工作的人數減少了，這意味著有更多居民留下來照料這片土地。

paragraphs.en: Co-author Dr Nick Langridge explained that when local communities enjoy greater autonomy and security, they can better protect nature. Lead author Dr Neil Howard noted that this respectful approach promotes ethical conservation without forcing rules on local people. To enhance the benefits, the project also offered voluntary classes on personal finance, conservation, and climate change.
paragraphs.zh: 該報告的共同作者尼克．蘭格里奇博士（Dr Nick Langridge）解釋，當在地社群享有更大的自主權與安全感時，他們就能更好地保護自然。主要作者尼爾．霍華德博士（Dr Neil Howard）指出，這種充滿尊重的做法促進了合乎道德的保育，而不會將規則強加於當地人身上。為了擴大效益，該計畫還提供了關於個人財務、保育和氣候變遷的自願性課程。

paragraphs.en: However, some scholars remain cautious about unconditional cash programs. In other regions, giving cash has sometimes increased forest loss because farmers used the extra income to clear more land for agriculture. In certain places, residents used the money to purchase cars or motorcycles, creating higher demand for roads that damage the forest.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一些學者對無條件現金發放計畫仍持謹慎態度。在其他地區，提供現金有時反而加劇了森林流失，因為農民利用這筆額外收入開墾更多土地從事農業。在某些地方，居民用這筆錢購買汽車或機車，進而產生對道路的更高需求，破壞了森林。

paragraphs.en: The authors admitted their study was small, covering just over 500 hectares of forest without measuring soil or plant changes directly. Even so, they hope their pioneering experiment will encourage larger studies and inspire new ways to support Indigenous communities.
paragraphs.zh: 作者們坦言他們的研究規模很小，僅涵蓋剛好超過五百公頃的森林，且並未直接測量土壤或植物的變化。即便如此，他們希望這項先導實驗能促成更大規模的研究，並啟發支持原住民社群的新方法。

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 that 引導名詞子句，在主要子句中作及物動詞 has shown 的受詞。
grammar.example: A groundbreaking project in Peru has shown that giving basic cash payments to Indigenous communities can help protect the Amazon rainforest.
grammar.focus: that giving basic cash payments to Indigenous communities can help protect the Amazon rainforest

grammar.point: 現在分詞片語作修飾語 (Present Participle Phrase as Modifier)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞 including 引導片語，用來列舉並補充說明前方名詞 habits 的具體內容。
grammar.example: Almost ninety percent of the participants chose to adopt environmentally friendly habits, including planting trees together and restoring vital water sources.
grammar.focus: including planting trees together and restoring vital water sources

grammar.point: 原因副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Reason)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞 because 引導副詞子句，用來說明主要子句中森林流失增加的原因。
grammar.example: In other regions, giving cash has sometimes increased forest loss because farmers used the extra income to clear more land for agriculture.
grammar.focus: because farmers used the extra income to clear more land for agriculture

lessons.title: SpaceX and Tesla have formed committees to discuss potential merger, Musk says
lessons.title_zh: 馬斯克表示 SpaceX 與特斯拉已成立委員會討論潛在合併事宜

paragraphs.en: Elon Musk, the chief executive officer of both SpaceX and Tesla, recently expressed support for combining the two firms during a company earnings call on Tuesday. Although rumors about this deal have circulated for a long time, special shareholder committees from each company will examine the proposal and make the final choice. Musk explained that he cannot take part in these discussions because he is a conflicted party.
paragraphs.zh: 同時擔任 SpaceX 與特斯拉執行長的伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk），週二在一場公司財報電話會議中，對合併這兩家公司表達了支持。儘管關於這項交易的傳聞已流傳許久，但兩家公司各自成立的特別股東委員會將會審查該提議並做出最終決定。馬斯克解釋，由於自己是具利益衝突的當事方，因此無法參與這些討論。

paragraphs.en: During the call, Musk stated that "there's a lot of merit to combining the companies." His comments marked his strongest public support yet for the potential agreement. In the past, he avoided giving a clear opinion right after SpaceX completed its major initial public offering in July. Even though Musk must stay out of the official talks, Tesla investors have usually followed his wishes in earlier votes.
paragraphs.zh: 在通話中，馬斯克表示「合併這些公司確實有許多好處」。他的言論代表了他迄今為止對這項潛在協議最強烈的公開支持。過去，在 SpaceX 於七月完成重大的首次公開募股（IPO）之後，他避免給予明確的意見。即便馬斯克必須置身於正式會談之外，特斯拉投資人在以往的表決中通常都會順從他的意願。

paragraphs.en: SpaceX also shared impressive financial results for its third quarter, returning to profitability after back-to-back quarterly losses this year. The company earned a net income of 4.4 billion dollars, while its quarterly revenue climbed to 14.6 billion dollars. This rapid growth was mainly driven by its Starlink satellite internet network and its Super Intelligence division, beating the expectations of Wall Street analysts. Following the news, SpaceX shares rose nearly five percent.
paragraphs.zh: SpaceX 也公布了令人矚目的第三季財務成果，在今年連續幾季虧損後轉虧為盈。該公司獲得了四十四億美元的淨利，而單季營收則攀升至一百四十六億美元。這波快速成長主要受到其星鏈（Starlink）衛星網路以及其「超級智慧」部門的推動，超越了華爾街分析師的預期。消息公布後，SpaceX 的股價上漲了近百分之五。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, a separate controversy surfaced just before the earnings call. A report from the Wall Street Journal claimed that Musk had slowed down a military-grade version of Starlink, which caught Ukrainian officials by surprise. Ukrainian leaders previously accused SpaceX of weakening their national defense by limiting satellite access. However, Musk insisted that the United States government owns the military system, meaning that American officials and the president determine any operational limits.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，財報電話會議前夕浮現了另一場爭議。《華爾街日報》的一篇報導稱，馬斯克放慢了軍事級星鏈的速度，令烏克蘭官員措手不及。烏克蘭領導人先前指責 SpaceX 藉由限制衛星存取來削弱其國防。然而，馬斯克堅稱美國政府擁有該軍事系統，這意味著美國官員與總統決定了任何運作上的限制。

phrases.zh: 使某人措手不及；出乎某人意料

grammar.point: 關係代名詞非限定用法 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的 which 為關係代名詞，引導非限定子句補充說明整件事，指放慢速度的舉動讓烏克蘭官員措手不及。
grammar.example: A report from the Wall Street Journal claimed that Musk had slowed down a military-grade version of Starlink, which caught Ukrainian officials by surprise.
grammar.focus: which caught Ukrainian officials by surprise

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞 beating 引導分詞構句，修飾前方的快速成長，表隨之產生的結果。
grammar.example: This rapid growth was mainly driven by its Starlink satellite internet network and its Super Intelligence division, beating the expectations of Wall Street analysts.
grammar.focus: beating the expectations of Wall Street analysts

grammar.point: 名詞子句 (Noun Clause)
grammar.explain: 連接詞 that 引導名詞子句，在句中作為動詞 insisted 的受詞，說明堅持陳述的內容。
grammar.example: However, Musk insisted that the United States government owns the military system, meaning that American officials and the president determine any operational limits.
grammar.focus: that the United States government owns the military system

lessons.title: In Europe, budget airlines thrive. Why not the US?
lessons.title_zh: 在歐洲，廉價航空蓬勃發展。為何美國卻不行？

paragraphs.en: In Europe, low-cost carriers enjoy tremendous success. Irish carrier Ryanair and English airline easyJet fly millions of travelers annually, with Ryanair carrying more than 200 million passengers last year. Analysts note that budget airlines now account for over 40% of short-haul seats across Europe. They keep fares cheap by strictly cutting operational expenses and charging travelers extra fees for baggage, seat selection, and in-person check-in.
paragraphs.zh: 在歐洲，低成本航空公司享有巨大的成功。愛爾蘭的瑞安航空（Ryanair）和英國的易捷航空（easyJet）每年載運數百萬名旅客，其中瑞安航空光是去年就載運了超過兩億名乘客。分析師指出，廉價航空公司目前佔據了全歐洲超過40%的短程航班座位。他們透過嚴格削減營運費用，並對行李、座位選擇以及臨櫃報到收取額外費用，以此維持便宜的票價。

paragraphs.en: Industry experts explain that this European model relies on ruthless efficiency. Garth Lund, who previously worked in leadership at Wizz Air, noted that European budget carriers are "unwavering in their commitment to low costs." For instance, they use secondary airports, board passengers from both front and back doors, and reduce turnaround times to under 30 minutes. In addition, flight crews return home each night, saving expensive hotel bills.
paragraphs.zh: 業界專家解釋，這種歐洲模式仰賴極高的效率。曾任威茲航空（Wizz Air）主管的加斯·倫德（Garth Lund）指出，歐洲廉航「對低成本的承諾堅定不移」。例如，他們使用次要機場、讓乘客從前門與後門同時登機，並將客機週轉時間縮短至30分鐘以內。此外，機組人員每天晚上都會回家，從而節省了昂貴的飯店住宿費用。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, this business model has struggled in the United States. Frontier, the largest American budget carrier, flew only 33 million passengers during the same period. Part of the difficulty is cultural; American travelers often attach a negative stigma to discount flying and dislike paying extra for bare-bones service. Furthermore, economic pressures like rising fuel prices have squeezed margins, causing Spirit Airlines to collapse earlier this year.
paragraphs.zh: 相較之下，這種商業模式在美國卻面臨苦戰。美國最大的廉價航空邊疆航空（Frontier）在同一時期僅載運了3300萬名乘客。部分困境在於文化差異；美國旅客往往對搭乘廉航貼上負面標籤，而且不喜歡為最基本的服務支付額外費用。此外，燃油價格上漲等經濟壓力壓縮了利潤空間，導致精神航空（Spirit Airlines）在今年稍早倒閉。

paragraphs.en: Finally, large American legacy airlines have learned how to fight off budget rivals. Companies such as Delta Air Lines and United Airlines introduced basic economy tickets that directly match discount fares. Because traditional carriers offer more comfort and reliable service, price-sensitive consumers often prefer them when ticket prices are similar. Consequently, remaining American discount carriers find it harder to raise fares and maintain steady profitability.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，美國大型傳統航空公司已經學會如何擊退廉航競爭對手。達美航空（Delta Air Lines）和聯合航空（United Airlines）等公司推出了直接與折扣票價競爭的基礎經濟艙機票。由於傳統航空公司提供更高的舒適度與可靠的服務，當機票價格相近時，對價格敏感的消費者往往更青睞它們。因此，美國現存的廉價航空公司發現更難調漲票價並維持穩定的獲利能力。

grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 who 引導非限定子句，補充說明專有名詞 Garth Lund 的身分背景。

grammar.point: 分詞構句表附隨結果 (Participle Construction Expressing Result)

grammar.focus: saving expensive hotel bills

lessons.title: Look of the Week: Jenna Ortega’s steel dress has a very human touch
lessons.title_zh: 本週造型：珍娜·奧特嘉的鋼鐵禮服展現濃濃的人情味

paragraphs.en: Actress Jenna Ortega recently caught everyone's attention at the New York premiere of her new movie, "Klara and the Sun." In the film, which is adapted from Kazuo Ishiguro's 2021 novel, Ortega portrays a helpful solar-powered robot named Klara. To celebrate the role, she wore a striking gown created by designer Elias Matso. The dress, featuring a fringe skirt and unique bustier, was crafted almost entirely from hand-cut steel boning normally hidden inside corsets.
paragraphs.zh: 女演員珍娜·奧特嘉（Jenna Ortega）最近在她新電影《克拉拉與太陽》（Klara and the Sun）的紐約首映會上吸引了所有人的目光。在這部改編自石黑一雄（Kazuo Ishiguro）2021年同名小說的電影中，奧特嘉飾演一位名叫克拉拉、樂於助人的太陽能機器人。為了慶祝這個角色，她穿上由設計師伊利亞斯·馬措（Elias Matso）打造的亮眼禮服。這件擁有流蘇裙襬和獨特馬甲的禮服，幾乎完全是由平時藏在馬甲內部的純手工切割鋼骨所製成。

paragraphs.en: Connecting fashion with technology is not a new idea. For decades, luxury designers have found creative inspiration in robots. In 1995, Thierry Mugler presented his famous robot suit, which actress Zendaya recently wore again. Furthermore, during a memorable 1999 runway show, designer Alexander McQueen used industrial robotic arms to spray paint a white dress. More recently, in 2024, the fashion house Schiaparelli incorporated old circuit boards and discarded mobile phones into its clothing designs.
paragraphs.zh: 將時尚與科技結合並不是一個新想法。數十年來，奢華設計師一直在機器人身上尋找創作靈感。1995年，蒂埃里·穆勒（Thierry Mugler）展示了他著名的機器人套裝，該套裝最近由女演員辛蒂亞（Zendaya）再次穿上。此外，在一場令人難忘的1999年伸展台大秀中，設計師亞歷山大·麥昆（Alexander McQueen）利用工業機械手臂在一件白色洋裝上噴漆。最近，在2024年，時尚品牌夏帕瑞麗（Schiaparelli）將廢棄的電路板和老舊手機融入其服裝設計中。

paragraphs.en: Today, the line between modern robotics and fashion is becoming even closer. Earlier this year, humanoid robots developed by Unitree Robotics danced at a major fashion event in Milan and later modeled wedding dresses on a runway in Shanghai. Meanwhile, tech company Meta worked with Ray-Ban and celebrity Kylie Jenner to make artificial intelligence glasses look more stylish.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，現代機器人技術與時尚之間的界線變得更加緊密。今年稍早，由宇樹科技（Unitree Robotics）開發的人形機器人在米蘭的一場大型時尚盛會上跳舞，隨後又在上海的伸展台上為婚紗走秀。與此同時，科技公司 Meta 與雷朋（Ray-Ban）以及名媛凱莉·詹娜（Kylie Jenner）合作，讓人工智慧眼鏡看起來更具美感。

paragraphs.en: However, experts believe that tech-inspired fashion succeeds best when it retains an analog and human feeling. While Matso's metallic outfit resembled the internal components of a machine, it actually relied on traditional tailoring materials and extensive manual labor. As Ortega explained, "It’s hand-made, human-made, a lot of effort." Matso also emphasized that completing the design required many failed trials, painful blisters, and supportive hands.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，專家認為受科技啟發的時尚在保有類比與人性感受時最為成功。雖然馬措的金屬服飾酷似機器的內部零件，但它實際上仰賴的是傳統製衣材料與大量手工。正如奧特嘉所言：「這是純手工打造、人工製成，耗費了大量心血。」馬措也強調，完成這項設計經歷了多次失敗的嘗試、痛苦的水泡以及許多雙給予支援的手。

grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 which 引導非限定子句，前後用逗號隔開，用來補充說明先行詞 the film。
grammar.example: In the film, which is adapted from Kazuo Ishiguro's 2021 novel, Ortega portrays a helpful solar-powered robot named Klara.

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語作後位修飾 (Past Participle Phrase as an Adjective)
grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語 created by... 置於名詞 a striking gown 後方，表達被動修飾的意涵。

lessons.title: ‘There’s a hunger to express yourself’: A dispatch from China’s most fashionable city
lessons.title_zh: 「每個人都渴望表達自己」：來自中國最時尚城市的報導

paragraphs.en: During the tail-end of Shanghai Fashion Week, a writer explored why Shanghai is considered China's most stylish city. X Zhu-Nowell, executive director and chief curator of the Rockbund Art Museum, noted that local kids are very adventurous and personal with their dressing choices. The historic Rockbund neighborhood itself features many Art Deco buildings, blending art and architecture to create a popular backdrop for fashion photography.
paragraphs.zh: 在上海時裝週尾聲，一位作家探討了為什麼上海被認為是中國最時尚的城市。洛克外灘美術館的執行館長兼首席策展人朱筱蕤指出，當地年輕人在穿衣選擇上非常勇於冒險且具個人特色。洛克外灘歷史街區本身擁有許多裝飾藝術風格的建築，融合了藝術與建築，成為時尚攝影熱門的背景。

paragraphs.en: The city's rapid development creates a strong sense of possibility. Landon Du, project director of the organizing committee, explained that China's fashion scene is young, and its designers and audience are also young. This energy encourages people to express themselves boldly. Many creators, such as Samuel Guì Yang, successfully bring traditional Chinese aesthetics into modern design to reflect a growing cultural confidence.
paragraphs.zh: 這座城市的高速發展營造出強烈的可能性感。籌備委員會專案總監杜達表示，中國的時尚界很年輕，其設計師和觀眾也很年輕。這種活力鼓勵人們勇敢表達自己。許多創作者（例如Samuel Guì Yang）成功地將傳統中國美學融入現代設計，反映出不斷增長的文化自信。

paragraphs.en: Local designers are also focusing on storytelling through their runway presentations. For instance, the designer duo behind Osschaert used a theater performance about memory and loss instead of a traditional runway. Meanwhile, other brands like Mark Gong and Shushu/Tong showcased romantic and retro styles that attracted wide attention from both local audiences and international stars.
paragraphs.zh: 本地設計師也透過伸展台發表來專注於說故事。例如，Osschaert背後的設計師雙人組用一場關於記憶與失落的戲劇表演取代了傳統伸展台。同時，其他品牌如Mark Gong和Shushu/Tong則展示了浪漫與復古風格，吸引了當地觀眾和國際巨星的廣泛關注。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 強調動作的承受者，結構為be動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: During the tail-end of Shanghai Fashion Week, a writer explored why Shanghai is considered China's most stylish city.
grammar.focus: is considered

lessons.title: We asked teens what schools should teach them about work. This is what they said
lessons.title_zh: 我們詢問青少年學校應該教他們哪些關於工作的事。以下是他們的說法

paragraphs.en: A recent survey conducted by Survation for the BBC reveals that more than four in ten UK teenagers want additional work experience opportunities while still in school. The online research asked two thousand young people aged thirteen to eighteen about the modern job market and the assistance they require. Many respondents also expressed a strong need for better guidance on how to apply for jobs effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 根據一項為英國廣播公司（BBC）所做的最新民調顯示，超過十分之四的英國青少年希望在校期間能有更多的工作經驗機會。這項由 Survation 進行的網路研究詢問了兩千位年齡在十三到十八歲之間的年輕人，關於現代就業市場以及他們所需要的協助。許多受訪者也強烈表達需要更多關於如何有效應徵工作的指導。

paragraphs.en: When asked about the specific skills they hope to learn, forty-four percent of teenagers pointed to practical work experience, and forty-three percent mentioned help with managing personal finances. Furthermore, forty-two percent looked for advice on job applications, while thirty-nine percent requested education on managing stress and mental health. Another thirty-eight percent wanted to improve their essential communication skills for future careers.
paragraphs.zh: 當被問及希望學習的具體技能時，百分之四十四的青少年指向實務工作經驗，百分之四十三則提到管理個人財務的協助。此外，百分之四十二尋求求職建議，同時百分之百分之三十九要求關於管理壓力和心理健康的教育。另外百分之三十八則希望提升未來職涯所需的關鍵溝通技巧。

paragraphs.en: During the Teen Summit hosted by Radio 5 Live and BBC Bitesize in Newcastle, several participants discussed the heavy burden of the cost of living. For instance, a young audience member named Haider explained that high insurance and fuel prices make owning a car very expensive for young drivers. Another teenager, Ella, shared that she struggled to pay for university application costs and admissions tests without finding a job first.
paragraphs.zh: 在由英國廣播公司廣播第五台（Radio 5 Live）與英國廣播公司 Bitesize（BBC Bitesize）於紐卡斯爾舉辦的青少年高峰會（Teen Summit）期間，幾位參與者討論了生活成本的沉重負擔。例如，一位名叫海德（Haider）的年輕觀眾解釋說，高昂的保險和燃料價格使得年輕駕駛養車非常昂貴。另一位青少年艾拉（Ella）則分享說，她在沒有先找到工作的情況下，很難支付大學申請費用和入學考試的費用。

paragraphs.en: To understand these challenges better, the BBC followed four students named Param, McKenzie, Jasmine, and Javaris as they experienced short-term work placements. Jasmine worked on logo designs at a web design agency and realized she might be unsuited for an office job, though it gave her a real taste of working life. Meanwhile, Param visited a social housing group where he learned that social skills are just as important as academic abilities in the workplace.
paragraphs.zh: 為了更深入了解這些挑戰，BBC 跟隨了四位名叫帕拉姆（Param）、麥肯齊（McKenzie）、茉莉（Jasmine）和賈瓦里斯（Javaris）的學生，體驗了短期工作實習。茉莉在一家網站設計公司從事標誌設計工作，並意識到自己可能不適合辦公室工作，儘管這讓她真正體驗到了工作生活。同時，帕拉姆參觀了一個社會住宅團體，在那裡他了解到在職場上社交技巧與學術能力一樣重要。

paragraphs.en: Javaris and McKenzie spent their placement at Siemens Energy, which challenged them to interact with strangers and observe different types of roles. Reflecting on future technology, nearly a third of the surveyed teenagers worried that artificial intelligence might negatively impact their future careers. However, over three-quarters of the young participants still felt generally positive about what lies ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 賈瓦里斯和麥肯齊在西門子能源（Siemens Energy）度過了他們的實習期，這挑戰了他們與陌生人互動並觀察不同類型職位的經驗。反思未來的科技時，將近三分之一受訪的青少年擔心人工智慧可能會對他們的未來職涯造成負面影響。然而，超過四分之三的年輕參與者對於未來依然感到大體上樂觀。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative clause)
grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞 Siemens Energy 的形容詞子句。
grammar.example: Javaris and McKenzie spent their placement at Siemens Energy, which challenged them to interact with strangers and observe different types of roles.
grammar.focus: which challenged them to interact with strangers and observe different types of roles

grammar.point: 副詞子句表時間 (Adverbial clause of time)
grammar.explain: 用來表示動作發生時間的從屬子句。
grammar.example: When asked about the specific skills they hope to learn, forty-four percent of teenagers pointed to practical work experience.
grammar.focus: When asked about the specific skills they hope to learn

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達進行某項行動的目的之動詞片語。
grammar.example: Many respondents also expressed a strong need for better guidance on how to apply for jobs effectively.
grammar.focus: on how to apply for jobs effectively

lessons.title: What if an AI bubble bursts — and that accelerates AI job losses?
lessons.title_zh: 如果人工智慧泡沫破裂——而且加速了人工智慧帶來的失業潮，那該怎麼辦？

paragraphs.en: Many economists worry about a possible AI double whammy, where an artificial intelligence bubble bursts and causes a recession that quickly replaces human workers. Historically, financial bubbles often start with revolutionary technologies. In his 1978 book, economist Charles Kindleberger showed that investors often become overly excited about new inventions. They borrow massive amounts of money to make big bets, creating heavy debt that can trigger a severe economic crisis when reality sets in.
paragraphs.zh: 許多經濟學家擔心可能出現「人工智慧雙重打擊」，即人工智慧泡沫破裂引發經濟衰退，進而迅速取代人類勞工。從歷史上看，金融泡沫往往始於革命性的新技術。經濟學家查爾斯·金德伯格（Charles Kindleberger）在他1978年的著作中指出，投資人往往對新發明過度興奮。他們借入巨額資金進行龐大押注，累積了沉重的債務，而當現實來臨時，這些債務可能引發嚴重的經濟危機。

paragraphs.en: Today, AI is heavily supporting the United States stock market. An analysis from J.P. Morgan found that only 42 AI-related companies drove about two-thirds of the S&P 500's gains since early 2024. These firms are borrowing hundreds of billions of dollars for data centers and power infrastructure. While the bursting of the dot-com bubble caused only a mild downturn because it involved less debt, technology analyst Benedict Evans warns that fierce competition might soon reduce AI profits.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，人工智慧正大力支撐著美國股市。摩根大通（J.P. Morgan）的一項分析發現，自2024年初以來，僅42家與人工智慧相關的公司就貢獻了標普500指數約三分之二的漲幅。這些公司正借貸數千億美元用於興建資料中心和電力基礎設施。雖然網路泡沫破裂時因涉及較少債務而僅導致輕微的景氣低迷，但科技分析師班奈迪克·埃文斯（Benedict Evans）警告，激烈的競爭可能很快就會削減人工智慧的獲利。

paragraphs.en: If an AI downturn occurs, it could speed up job losses. Research by economists Nir Jaimovich and Henry Siu shows that automation does not always happen gradually. Between 1990 and 2017, 88 percent of the job decline in vulnerable fields took place during or around recessions. In tough times, companies eagerly cut costs. A market drop could make AI tools cheaper, tempting struggling businesses to replace workers with machines even faster.
paragraphs.zh: 如果人工智慧陷入低迷，可能會加速工作崗位的流失。經濟學家尼爾·賈莫維奇（Nir Jaimovich）和亨利·蕭（Henry Siu）的研究表明，自動化並不總是循序漸進地發生。在1990年至2017年間，易受自動化影響的工作中，有88%的職位減少是發生在經濟衰退期間或其前後。在艱難時期，企業會急於削減成本。市場下滑可能會使人工智慧工具變得更便宜，誘使陷入困境的企業更快地用機器取代勞工。

paragraphs.en: Fortunately, this dark scenario is not guaranteed to happen. AI might help workers become more productive instead of fully replacing them. Furthermore, governments could strengthen safety nets through unemployment insurance or consider proposals like Bill Gates' idea to tax robots. Such policies could encourage firms to keep human workers and reduce the damage of economic shocks.
paragraphs.zh: 幸運的是，這種噩夢般的場景並非一定會發生。人工智慧可能會幫助勞工提高生產力，而不是完全取代他們。此外，政府可以透過失業保險加強安全防護網，或考慮像比爾·蓋茲（Bill Gates）所提出的對機器人課稅的建議。這類政策可以鼓勵企業繼續僱用人類員工，並減少經濟衝擊所造成的損害。

vocab.zh: 富有成效的；生產力高的

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語「to make big bets」在此作副詞修飾動詞，表示借入巨額資金的「目的」是為了進行重大押注。
grammar.example: They borrow massive amounts of money to make big bets, creating heavy debt that can trigger a severe economic crisis when reality sets in.
grammar.focus: to make big bets

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「that」引導形容詞子句修飾先行詞「heavy debt」，並在該子句中擔任主詞。

lessons.title: Can the new federal voucher program help public schools? Democrats are torn
lessons.title_zh: 聯邦學費補助方案能否幫助公立學校？民主黨人陷入意見分歧

paragraphs.en: A new federal scholarship program created by the Trump administration has caused a serious political debate among Democrats in the United States. The program offers a generous tax credit to taxpayers who donate to scholarship-granting organizations, also known as SGOs. These donations are converted into vouchers to help families pay for education costs such as private school tuition, tutoring, and summer school. While Republican leaders strongly support the policy, Democratic governors and public school advocates remain deeply divided over whether to participate.
paragraphs.zh: 由川普政府建立的一項新的聯邦獎學金計畫，在美國民主黨人之間引發了嚴重的政治辯論。該計畫向捐款給獎學金發放組織（即SGO）的納稅人提供豐厚的稅收抵免。這些捐款被轉換成代金券，以幫助家庭支付私立學校學費、家教和暑期學校等教育費用。雖然共和黨領袖強烈支持這項政策，但民主黨州長和公立學校倡導者對於是否參與仍然意見分歧。

paragraphs.en: Colorado Governor Jared Polis became the first Democratic governor to opt in to the program, stating that he wanted local children to benefit from the billions of dollars raised nationwide. In contrast, Minnesota Governor Tim Walz clearly stated that his state would not join the plan. Meanwhile, fifteen other Democratic governors and the mayor of Washington, D.C., remain undecided as a strict January deadline approaches. To be able to participate next year, state leaders must make their final choice by January first.
paragraphs.zh: 科羅拉多州長傑瑞德·波利斯成為第一位選擇加入該計畫的民主黨州長，並表示他希望當地兒童能受益於全國籌集的數十億美元。相比之下，明尼蘇達州長蒂姆·瓦爾茲明確表示他的州不會加入該計畫。同時，隨著一月份的截止日期逼近，其他十五位民主黨州長和華盛頓特區市長仍未做出決定。為了能在明年參與，州領導人必須在一月一日前做出最終選擇。

paragraphs.en: Critics like Jessica Levin from the Education Law Center argue that the policy is a Trojan horse that could harm public education. Because the program helps families afford private schools, critics fear it will lead to reduced funding for public schools. On the other hand, organizations like the Southern Education Foundation have decided to take a practical approach. Instead of fighting the policy, they are launching new groups to raise funds specifically for public school students so they can receive helpful services like tutoring and afterschool programs.
paragraphs.zh: 來自教育法律中心的潔西卡·萊文等批評者主張，這項政策是一匹可能傷害公立教育的特洛伊木馬。由於該計畫幫助家庭負擔得起私立學校，批評者擔心這會導致公立學校資金減少。另一方面，南方教育基金會等組織決定採取務實的做法。他們沒有對抗這項政策，而是發起新的團體，專門為公立學校學生籌集資金，以便他們能夠獲得家教和課後計畫等有益的服務。

paragraphs.en: Supporters note that qualifying donors can receive every penny back from the Internal Revenue Service up to one thousand seven hundred dollars. However, public schools face significant challenges in using these funds because they are required to provide traditional education free of charge. Unlike private schools that can legally charge tuition, public schools can only use donations for specific extra services like field trips and tutoring hours. Experts point out that school districts must actively work with SGOs and local employers to make the system work for their communities.
paragraphs.zh: 支持者指出，符合條件的捐款人可以從美國國稅局拿回每一分錢，最高可達一千七百美元。然而，公立學校在利用這些資金時面臨重大挑戰，因為他們被要求免費提供傳統教育。與可以合法收取學費的私立學校不同，公立學校只能將捐款用於校外教學和家教時間等特定的額外服務。專家指出，學區必須積極與SGO及當地雇主合作，才能讓這個系統為他們的社區發揮作用。

lessons.title: ‘Once-in-a-lifetime chance’: Japan launches historic mission to collect rocks from Mars’s moon Phobos
lessons.title_zh: 「千載難逢的機會」：日本展開歷史性任務前往火星衛星「火衛一」採集岩石

paragraphs.en: Japan has successfully sent a spacecraft into space to collect rock samples from one of Mars's moons. Propelled by the flagship H3 rocket, the Martian Moons Exploration (MMX) probe lifted off before dawn from the Tanegashima Space Centre. The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) announced that the spacecraft had separated smoothly from the rocket, which brought great excitement to flight controllers.
paragraphs.zh: 日本已成功將一艘太空船送入太空，以從火星的一顆衛星採集岩石樣本。在旗艦級 H3 火箭的推進下，「火星衛星探測」（MMX）探測器在黎明前從種子島太空中心升空。日本宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）宣布太空船已與火箭順利分離，這為飛行控制人員帶來了極大的興奮。

paragraphs.en: The primary goal of this five-year mission is Phobos, an uneven, potato-shaped moon orbiting Mars. The five-tonne spacecraft is expected to enter Mars's orbit in August next year. When it reaches its destination, the main craft will deploy a small French-German rover called Idefix. Because gravity on Phobos is extremely weak, the rover will bounce for several minutes before stopping. It will spend one hundred days examining the surface to select safe landing locations.
paragraphs.zh: 這項為期五年的任務主要目標是火衛一（Phobos），這是一顆形狀不規則、形似馬鈴薯並環繞火星運行的衛星。這艘五公噸重的太空船預計將於明年八月進入火星軌道。當抵達目的地時，主太空船將釋放一輛名為 Idefix 的法德合作小型探測車。由於火衛一上的重力極為微弱，該探測車在停下之前將會彈跳數分鐘。它將花費一百天的時間勘測表面，以挑選安全的著陸地點。

paragraphs.en: After the initial survey, a four-legged lander will touch down on Phobos to drill and vacuum up at least ten grams of material. This collection process will take only two hours before the lander lifts off again. The spacecraft will also observe Mars's smaller moon, Deimos, before departing Mars's orbit in November 2030, with an expected return to Earth in 2031. German Space Agency rover chief Markus Grebenstein stated, "It is a once-in-a-lifetime chance."
paragraphs.zh: 在初步探勘之後，一架四腳著陸器將降落在火衛一上，以鑽探並吸取至少十公克的物質。這項採集過程在著陸器再次升空前僅需花費兩個小時。該太空船還將在 2030 年 11 月離開火星軌道之前觀察火星較小的衛星火衛二（Deimos），預計將於 2031 年返回地球。德國太空總署探測車主管 Markus Grebenstein 表示：「這是一個千載難逢的機會。」

paragraphs.en: Five international space agencies are working together on this 578-million-dollar project. Scientists hope the gathered rocks will resolve how the two moons formed—whether through a massive collision or by Mars capturing passing asteroids. In addition, the findings may reveal how habitable environments developed on terrestrial planets and assist upcoming human missions to Mars.
paragraphs.zh: 五個國際太空機構正在這個耗資 5.78 億美元的計畫中攜手合作。科學家希望收集到的岩石能解答這兩顆衛星是如何形成的——究竟是透過劇烈的天體撞擊，還是由火星捕獲路過的微行星。此外，這些發現或許能揭示類地行星上如何形成適合居住的環境，並有助於未來的載人火星任務。

paragraphs.en: Both the United States and China are also competing to retrieve Martian material. Although NASA's Perseverance rover has collected samples on Mars, its return journey was halted by the Trump administration. Meanwhile, China aims to launch its Tianwen-3 mission around 2028, meaning its samples could arrive on Earth as early as 2031.
paragraphs.zh: 美國與中國也正在競爭取回火星物質。儘管美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）的「毅力號」探測車已在火星採集樣本，但其返回地球的行程被川普政府叫停。與此同時，中國計畫在 2028 年左右發射「天問三號」任務，這意味著其樣本最早可能在 2031 年抵達地球。

lessons.title: In Dublin, tech workers raise concerns about AI
lessons.title_zh: 在都柏林，科技工作者對人工智慧表達憂慮

paragraphs.en: Dublin, Ireland, serves as a major hub for American technology companies, hosting European headquarters for firms like Google, Meta and Microsoft. While the Irish government recently organized a conference to highlight how artificial intelligence helps European competitiveness and innovation, a group of former tech workers and union organizers held a counter-summit to discuss their concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 愛爾蘭都柏林是美國科技公司的主要樞紐，也是Google、Meta和微軟等企業歐洲總部的所在地。雖然愛爾蘭政府最近舉辦了一場會議，強調人工智慧如何助益歐洲的競爭力與創新，但一群前科技工作者與工會組織者卻舉辦了一場反向高峰會來討論他們的憂慮。

paragraphs.en: The counter-summit was organized by John Bohan, a tech union organizer connected with the Communication Workers' Union, which represents some Irish tech workers. Approximately seventy individuals gathered for workshops, documentary screenings, and panel discussions to address the impacts of artificial intelligence on workplaces.
paragraphs.zh: 這場反向高峰會是由科技工會組織者約翰·博漢（John Bohan）所組織，他與代表部分愛爾蘭科技工作者的「通訊工人工會」（Communication Workers' Union）有關聯。大約七十個人齊聚一堂參加工作坊、紀錄片放映以及座談會，以探討人工智慧對職場的衝擊。

paragraphs.en: Participants discussed various worries, including the potential for artificial intelligence to replace human jobs. Jennifer Paz, who was recently laid off from a job that involved training artificial intelligence bots to moderate content, fears that these roles could disappear. Another speaker, Dr. Abeba Birhane, who is an artificial intelligence accountability professor at Trinity College Dublin, warned that relying too heavily on artificial intelligence might eventually cause a knowledge collapse.
paragraphs.zh: 參與者討論了各種憂慮，包含人工智慧取代人類工作的可能性。珍妮佛·帕斯（Jennifer Paz）最近從一份培訓人工智慧機器人來審核內容的工作被資遣，她擔心這些職位可能會消失。另一位講者愛貝巴·比爾漢（Abeba Birhane）博士是都柏林聖三一學院的人工智慧問責教授，她警告過度依賴人工智慧最終可能會導致知識崩潰。

paragraphs.en: At the conclusion of the event, the union planned to present these ideas to an Irish Parliamentary subcommittee. John Bohan encouraged participants by saying, 'It's up to us to steer the ship towards optimism.'
paragraphs.zh: 在活動尾聲，工會計畫將這些想法提交給愛爾蘭議會的一個次級委員會。約翰·博漢（John Bohan）鼓勵參與者說：「我們必須掌握方向盤，朝著樂觀前進。」

lessons.title: Schools struggle to measure how much AI experiments are helping
lessons.title_zh: 學校難以衡量人工智慧實驗帶來了多少助益

paragraphs.en: Schools across the nation are actively experimenting with various artificial intelligence tools in their classrooms. For example, some districts use AI chatbots to give students feedback on their assignments. However, educational institutions are encountering a major problem because it is very hard to measure whether this new technology is actually good or bad for students.
paragraphs.zh: 全美各地的學校正積極在教室中試驗各種人工智慧工具。例如，某些學区利用人工智慧聊天機器人來給予學生的作業回饋。然而，教育機構正遭遇一個重大問題，因為要衡量這項新科技對學生到底是好是壞非常困難。

paragraphs.en: At a school in Dayton, Ohio, a high school senior participated in an experiment last school year by interacting with an AI chatbot named Jordan. The chatbot asked the student for advice on handling difficult situations, such as dealing with adults' expectations. The student found it easy to connect with the system because he had experienced similar things, and the chatbot graded his supportive responses with high marks.
paragraphs.zh: 在俄亥俄州代頓的一所學校，一名高中高年級學生在上一學年透過與名為喬丹的聊天機器人互動來參與一項實驗。該聊天機器人向該學生徵詢處理困難情況的建議，例如應付成年的期望。該學生發現與該系統建立連結很容易，因為他經歷過類似的事情，且聊天機器人給予他支持性的回答很高的分數。

paragraphs.en: Despite these high marks, there is simply no way to quantify how much the chatbot is actually helping students. A consultant named Mike Kentz stated that every test and experiment he tried to evaluate only led back to subjective perception. Robin Lake, who leads the Center on Reinventing Public Education, noted that educators often struggle to evaluate the value of rapidly produced technology while feeling completely overwhelmed.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管分數很高，但根本沒有辦法量化聊天機器人實際上對學生有多少幫助。一位名叫麥克·肯茨的顧問表示，他試圖以某種具體方式評估的每一項測試和實驗，最後都只能得出主觀看法。帶領重塑公共教育中心的羅賓·萊克指出，教育工作者在感到徹底不知所措的同時，往往難以評估快速產出的科技之價值。

paragraphs.en: Because of this uncertainty, Mike Kentz is cautious about scaling up the chatbot as a full-scale solution. Similarly, Katelyn Schoenhofer, an AI specialist for Wichita Public Schools in Kansas, explained that her district is introducing tools like educational game coding and a math tutor very slowly. These small-scale experiments will continue because students need to be educated about technology that will definitely impact their lives.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這種不確定性，麥克·肯茨對於將該聊天機器人擴大規模作為全面解決方案持謹慎態度。同樣地，堪薩斯州威奇托公立學校的人工智慧專家凱特琳·舍恩霍弗解釋說，她的學區正非常緩慢地引進諸如教育遊戲編碼和數學家教等工具。這些小規模實驗將會持續，因為學生需要接受關於肯定會影響他們生活的科技之教育。

paragraphs.en: Robin Lake agrees that stopping the experiments is not the right answer, as kids must learn to navigate a rapidly changing world. She suggests that governments need to establish guardrails around these school experiments so that students can be properly prepared for the future.
paragraphs.zh: 羅賓·萊克同意停止實驗並非正確答案，因為孩子們必須學會應對瞬息萬變的世界。她建議政府需要在這些學校實驗周圍建立保護措施，以便學生能為未來做好充分準備。

lessons.title: Mars’ two tiny moons shouldn’t exist. A new mission has launched to reveal their secrets
lessons.title_zh: 火星的兩顆微小衛星本不該存在。一項新任務已發射升空以揭開它們的祕密

paragraphs.en: A groundbreaking space mission has recently launched to investigate Mars' two mysterious moons, Phobos and Deimos. Although scientists have observed these strange, lumpy objects for decades, their true origin remains an unsolved riddle. The Japanese-led Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission aims to study these bodies closely and collect samples directly from Phobos to uncover their long-standing cosmic secrets.
paragraphs.zh: 一項開創性的太空任務最近發射升空，以調查火星的兩顆神祕衛星：火衛一（Phobos）與火衛二（Deimos）。雖然科學家數十年來一直在觀察這些形狀不規則的奇特天體，但它們真正的起源仍然是一個未解之謎。由日本主導的「火星衛星探測」（MMX）任務旨在密切研究這些星體，並直接從火衛一採集樣本，以揭開它們長久以來的宇宙祕密。

paragraphs.en: The MMX spacecraft lifted off aboard an H3 rocket from the Tanegashima Space Center in southwestern Japan. This challenging mission is an international collaboration that includes scientific instruments from space agencies in the United States, Europe, France, and Germany. If successful, the spacecraft will deliver more than ten grams of collected material back to Earth in 2031, potentially making it the first mission to bring Martian material home.
paragraphs.zh: MMX 太空船從日本西南部的種子島宇宙中心搭乘 H3 火箭升空。這項艱巨的任務是一項國際合作計畫，包含來自美國、歐洲、法國和德國太空機構的科學儀器。如果一切順利，該太空船將於 2031 年將超過十公克採集到的物質帶回地球，這可能使其成為首個將火星物質帶回地球的任務。

paragraphs.en: American astronomer Asaph Hall first discovered both moons in 1877. Today, scientists are evaluating two major hypotheses about how they formed. One theory suggests that a massive impact on Mars launched rocky debris that later gathered together into moons. The other hypothesis proposes that they are stray asteroids pulled in by the gravity of Mars. As NASA scientist Dr. Abigail Fraeman noted, "They shouldn’t exist, but they do."
paragraphs.zh: 美國天文學家阿薩夫．霍爾（Asaph Hall）於 1877 年首次發現了這兩顆衛星。如今，科學家正在評估關於它們如何形成的兩大假說。一種理論認為，火星遭受巨大撞擊後噴射出岩石碎片，這些碎片隨後聚集成了衛星。另一種假說則主張，它們是被火星重力吸引過來的流浪小行星。正如美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）科學家艾比蓋爾．弗雷曼（Dr. Abigail Fraeman）博士所指出的：「它們本不該存在，但它們確實存在。」

paragraphs.en: Before touching down, the spacecraft will deploy a small robotic rover named Idefix to test the low-gravity surface and scout safe landing locations. The lander will then visit two distinct sites on Phobos, using a drill and gas equipment to gather surface dust and underground rocks. Scientists believe these valuable samples will illuminate the formation of the moons and support future human exploration of Mars.
paragraphs.zh: 在著陸之前，太空船將釋放一輛名為「伊德菲克斯」（Idefix）的小型機器探測車，以測試微弱重力的地表並勘察安全的著陸點。接著，著陸器將造訪火衛一上的兩個不同地點，利用鑽頭與氣體設備收集地表塵埃和地下岩石。科學家相信，這些珍貴的樣本將闡明這些衛星的形成過程，並為未來的火星載人探索提供支援。

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 although 引導副詞子句，表示「雖然、儘管」，用以對比後方主要子句的內容。
grammar.example: Although scientists have observed these strange, lumpy objects for decades, their true origin remains an unsolved riddle.
grammar.focus: Although scientists have observed these strange, lumpy objects for decades

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 that 在子句中作主詞，指稱先行詞 rocky debris，並引導形容詞子句修飾該名詞。
grammar.example: One theory suggests that a massive impact on Mars launched rocky debris that later gathered together into moons.
grammar.focus: that later gathered together into moons

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語在此處作副詞，用來說明釋放小型探測車的主要目的。
grammar.example: Before touching down, the spacecraft will deploy a small robotic rover named Idefix to test the low-gravity surface and scout safe landing locations.
grammar.focus: to test the low-gravity surface and scout safe landing locations

lessons.title: Starwatch: Catch the Orionid meteor shower streak across the night sky
lessons.title_zh: 觀星指南：捕捉獵戶座流星雨劃過夜空的景象

paragraphs.en: Stargazers around the world have an exciting opportunity this week as the annual Orionid meteor shower reaches its peak. This celestial event gives sky watchers a special chance to view glowing fragments from Halley’s comet, which is widely considered the most famous comet in history, as they dash across the dark sky.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著一年一度的獵戶座流星雨在本週達到極大期，全球的天文愛好者迎來了一個令人興奮的機會。這場天文盛事為觀星者提供了一個難得的機會，能觀賞歷史上最著名彗星——哈雷彗星所產生的發光碎片劃過黑暗的夜空。

paragraphs.en: The Orionids take place every October when our planet travels through a trail of cosmic dust left behind by Halley’s comet. As these tiny space particles rush into Earth’s atmosphere at a speed of approximately 66 kilometres per second, they rub against and heat the surrounding air. This intense friction creates the brief, bright flashes of light that people observe as meteors.
paragraphs.zh: 獵戶座流星雨於每年十月發生，此時我們的地球會穿過哈雷彗星所留下的宇宙塵埃帶。當這些微小的太空顆粒以每秒約六十六公里的速度衝入地球大氣層時，它們會摩擦並加熱周圍的空氣。這種劇烈的摩擦產生了短暫而明亮的光芒，也就是人們所看到的流星。

paragraphs.en: This year, the astronomical display is predicted to hit its greatest activity during the night of 21 to 22 October. Under perfect viewing conditions, observers might be able to count between 10 and 20 meteors every hour. However, the viewing environment this year is far from perfect because of a bright waxing gibbous Moon, whose intense glow will unfortunately drown out many of the fainter shooting stars.
paragraphs.zh: 今年，這場天文景觀預計會在十月二十一日至二十二日的夜間達到活動最盛期。在理想的觀賞條件下，觀測者每小時可能可以數到十至二十顆流星。然而，由於一輪明亮的盈凸月出現，今年的觀賞環境並不理想，因為其強烈的光芒不幸地會掩蓋許多較暗的流星。

paragraphs.en: Even so, the situation becomes much better in the early hours before sunrise. The moon sets at around 03:00 British Summer Time (BST), which creates a window of darker skies for several hours prior to dawn. During this time, the constellation of Orion gradually rises high into the night sky, making the viewing experience significantly more rewarding.
paragraphs.zh: 即便如此，在日出前的清晨時分，情況會改善許多。月亮大約在英國夏令時間（BST）凌晨三點西沉，在破曉前留下了數小時較為黑暗的夜空。在這段時間內，獵戶座逐漸升高到夜空的高處，使得觀賞體驗大幅提升。

paragraphs.en: For those wishing to enjoy the sight, experts suggest finding a safe area that provides the widest possible view of the open sky. Special equipment like telescopes is not necessary, as the display can simply be viewed with the naked eye. In London, people looking towards the south-east at midnight on the night of 21 to 22 October can see the meteors, which appear to spread outwards from a location near Orion.
paragraphs.zh: 對於希望欣賞這項美景的人，專家建議尋找一個能提供最寬廣開闊天空視野的安全地點。像望遠鏡之類的特殊設備並非必要，因為用肉眼就能直接觀看這場盛宴。在倫敦，十月二十一日轉為二十二日午夜時分望向東南方的民眾，可以看到這些流星似乎從靠近獵戶座的位置向外散發出來。

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由逗號隔開的「which」引導非限定關係子句，用來對前方先行詞「Halley's comet」補充額外說明。
grammar.example: This celestial event gives sky watchers a special chance to view glowing fragments from Halley’s comet, which is widely considered the most famous comet in history, as they dash across the dark sky.
grammar.focus: , which is widely considered the most famous comet in history,

grammar.point: 現在分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後方使用現在分詞「making」，構成表示伴隨結果的分詞構句，說明獵戶座升起所帶來的效果。
grammar.example: During this time, the constellation of Orion gradually rises high into the night sky, making the viewing experience significantly more rewarding.
grammar.focus: , making the viewing experience significantly more rewarding

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由情態助動詞「can」搭配「be + 過去分詞（viewed）」組成，表示主詞「the display」能被觀賞的被動概念。
grammar.example: Special equipment like telescopes is not necessary, as the display can simply be viewed with the naked eye.
grammar.focus: can simply be viewed
